cs.label: [section] Požadavky na ukončení:
cs.content: Průběžné hodnocení zahrnuje aktivity k ověření praktických znalostí a dovedností z 5 cvičeních. Úspěšné splnění zadání je hodnoceno max. 10 body za aktivitu, přičemž hodnotí se 4 nejúspěšnější aktivity studenta. Pátá slouží pro účely náhrady nebo opravy. Celkem student musí získat z těchto aktivit alespoň 20 bodů (50 %) z maxima 40 bodů. Závěrečná zkouška je praktická a je hodnocena maximálně 50 body, minimálně je nutné získat 25 bodů (50 %). Dále proběhne certifikační zkouška, na kterou má student pouze 1 pokus. Tato zkouška bude hodnocena 10 body, minumum stanoveno není. Známka: A 100-90, B 89-83, C 82-75, D 74-68, E 67-60, F méně než 60.

en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: The aim of the course is to acquaint students with configuration of MikroTik nework devices and prepare students for certification exam MTCNA.

en.label: [section] Course content:
en.content: 1.Introduction to network devices MikroTik (allowance 1/3) a.technology MikroTikb.model seriesc.RouterOSd.ways of MikroTik devices managemente.command line syntaxf.basic configuration2.Management of MikroTik network devices (allowance 1/3) a.updatesb.package managementc.backup and restore configurationd.licensing3.DHCP and ARP (allowance 1/3) a.protocol DHCP – client, server and relay configuration; management DHCP leasesb.protocol ARP - modes, settings, ARP table and static records in ARP table4.Switching on RouterOS (allowance 1/3) a.configuration of logical interfacesb.switching based on hardware architecture5.Routing on RouterOS (allowance 1/3) a.routing table and states of individual recordsb.configuration od static and dynamic routing6.Wireless connection (allowance 2/6) a.802.11 a/b/g/n/ac/axb.frequency rangesc.output powerd.regional restrictionse.wireless interface modesf.wireless securityg.wireless network monitoring7.Firewall (allowance 2/6) a.principle of firewall on RouterOSb.filtering input and forwarding trafficc.source and destination NAT8.QoS a queuing mechanisms (allowance 2/6) a.QoS principlesb.constraining of transmission speed using Simple Queue and PCQ9.Tunnel mechanisms and VPN (allowance 2/6) a.PPP conceptb.authentication in local network using PPPoEc.VPN using SSTP and IPsec10.Other tools and monitoring (allowance 1/3) a.specialized tools for diagnostic of network and device stateb.monitoring of network statec.solving problems

en.label: [section] Assessment methods:
en.content: Preliminary includes activities to verify practical knowledge and skills from selected 5 exercises. Successful completion of the activity is evaluated with a maximum of 10 points per activity, while the 4 best scores from activities are counted. The fifth is for replacement or correction purposes. In total, the student must obtain from these activities at least 20 points (50%) out of a maximum of 40 points. The final exam is practical and student can achieve up to 50 points, where the passing minimum is 25 points (50%). There wiil be also certification exam, where has student only 1 attempt. This exam will be evaluated with 10 point and there is no necessary minimum. Evaluation: A 100-90 p., B 89-83 p., C 82-75 p., D 74-68 p., E 67-60 p., F less than 60 points.
